content: Obushinganyanya burhalondôla
Sofari w’e Nâmati aj’eluhya aderha, erhi:
Enkengêro zâni zamambwîriza ishuzo, bwo n’obu ndwîrhe nakanâna nti nshuze.
Nayumvîrhe ebinwa bimbabazize, Ci obukengêre bwâni bwampwehwerhîze ishuzo,
K’orhîshi kurhenga mîra, Kurhenga omuntu ali bano igulu,
Oku obushagaluke bw’enkola-maligo bubà bunyi, n’oku amasîma gw’omuntu mubî gabà ga kasanzi kasungunu?
Ciru omujunja gwâge gwankalwîra omu lya mazihwa, ciru irhwe lyâge lyankahuma oku bitù,
anahirigirhe nka muzimu, abamuyishi mpu «ngahi àjirage?»
Anabalale nka cilôrho cirhankakengêrwa, analibirhe nka bilôrha by’omu budufu.
Amasù gakomeraga akumubona gamuziguluke, Aha mwâge harhakacimushish’isù!
Bagala bâge balyûle amabî àjirîre abakenyi, bagala bâge banalyûla ebirugu byâge;
Amavurha gâge gali gayunjwîre misî ya busole: ye n’obusole bwâge, bamâlambama omu katulo.
Akaginunirwa n’amabî, Garhahusagya oku lulimi lwâge,
Akagigabikirira bwinjà, agagobere ebiraka byâge.
Ebyo biryo byâge bikola bibolêreza omu nda yâge, bikola bimuli omu nda nka bôge bwa manjokà-njokà.
Kukwânîne ashale amagala àmirangusize, Na Nyamuzinda wamushazago.
Anunugusire obôge, Lulimi lw’igû lwamuyîrha.
Irhondo arhakacibona emikôndo yahulula, emikôndo y’obûci n’ey’amakafè.
Alyûla ebi àlîre, ayihikwe anahongôkwe, kulya àkâg’ibijandâga arhakacikujira bundi.
Kulya kubà àshâbîre abakenyi enyumpa anabalibuza, enyumpa aj’azinyaga ahâli h’akuziyûbaka.
Bulya àli wa masù, arhànayigurhaga, obugale bwâge burhamulikûze;
Bulya ntâye arhalibuzagya omu magene gâge, obwôloloke bwâge burhankarhinda.
Oku aciri ajêjêrhwa n’ebirugu, arhemuke n’omusisi, emihimbagulizo y’obuhanya emurhogerekwo
Nyamuzinda anamurhogezekwo obukunizi bwâge bunene, anamurhulirekwo obwîre bw’emyampi yâge.
Akafuma emirasano y’ebyûma, muherho gwa mulinga gwamurhulûla.
Ecisonga camâmuyisha emugongo, ecûma calangashana camâmurhulûngula obudiku, obuhanya bwamâmurhogera,
Endunduli zoshi ye zibîkîrwe mpu zimuhûnjukane, Omuliro gurhayâsîbwi na ndi
gwamâmusingônola, gwamâmalîra na gasi byàli bicimusigalire omu nyumpa.
Amalunga gamâmanyîsa obubî bwâge, n’igulu lyamuhindukira.
Obugale bwâge bwamâshandâla, bwamâhirigirha omu kasânzi k’obukunizi.
Lwo luhembo Nyamuzinda abîkîre enkola-maligo olwo, owahehêrirwe, co cigabi Nyamuzinda amutwira eco!
